rules: Any liquid asset: stock, crypto, or leveraged/inverse ETF
Rotate each 6:30am CT run — sell yesterday, buy today's best
Leverage matched to conviction; asymmetric payoff preferred
Hard stop at entry; spot-crypto-only on weekends

positions.name: Bitcoin
positions.catalyst: BTC broke above the key $61K resistance (former ceiling now support) on the dovish-Fed/cooler-jobs risk-on relief rally, consolidating $61.0-61.8K; broad crypto follow-through (ETH +~5%, SOL firm) confirms buyer control.
positions.driver: Un-rotatable 3-day hold (Jul 3 equity holiday + weekend, no rotation until Mon 6:30am CT), so downside protection dominates: spot BTC is the lowest-vol major, offering risk-on participation with the least single-asset flush risk. $61K reclaim gives a tight, defined invalidation while the relief-rally momentum stays intact.
positions.risks: Weekend risk-off reversal back below $61K support (retest $59-60K); thinner holiday/weekend liquidity can amplify a flush. Spot (unleveraged) bounds the drawdown to BTC's own volatility; SOL was avoided (crowded 78% longs, flush-prone) and ETH is higher-beta.
